observation.visible_scene: Indoor training space with a plain white wall and a dark padded mat floor whose seam lines are visible. A small pink downward-arrow logo sits fixed in the upper-left corner (overlay). A shirtless, bearded man in light-grey shorts is held in a low, hands-on-the-ground crouch, torso roughly horizontal, head facing down toward the right of the frame.
visible_changes: The man's whole body gradually translates forward (toward the right of the frame): his head moves from left-of-center to right-of-center, and his trailing foot moves from the far-left edge toward the middle of the frame.

His trailing leg changes configuration from an extended position with the heel lifted off the mat to a bent position with the knee lowered toward the mat and the foot flat, then the foot slides forward.
His hands are repositioned sequentially in a crawl-like pattern: one hand stays planted while the other lifts, reaches forward, and plants ahead of it, repeating as the body advances.
The leading (forward-planted) hand shifts progressively to the right along with the body.
A bright diagonal light streak / flare appears on the wall behind the subject's back partway through the clip and persists to the end (a lighting change, not a separate object).
The background wall and floor seams remain fixed throughout, indicating the camera is stationary while the subject moves.
outside_clip_unknowns: The name or purpose of the drill and what the man does before this excerpt begins or after it ends (e.g., whether he stands up or continues crawling).
Whether the limb repositioning is part of a larger repeated cycle or a single transition.
The cause of the wall light streak (moving light source vs. reflection).
uncertain_details: Exact left/right identification of the arms and legs, since the body is angled and limbs overlap.
The precise order and timing of hand and foot contacts (some frames show a hand in mid-reach, others planted).
Whether the trailing knee fully touches the mat or only approaches it.
